findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_list_filings, free_sample, sec_filing_section, scrape_markdown, scrape_batch, site_map, email_verify, counterparty_check, sec_ipo_filings, x402_preflight, web_search · Private data: token_launches_peek, sec_financials, sec_insider_trades, sec_full_text_search, company_profile, company_dossier, scrape_markdown, scrape_batch, site_map, domain_enrich, email_verify, sanctions_screen, counterparty_check, token_verdict, sec_fund_holdings, wallet_risk_check, token_risk_check, new_token_launches, x402_preflight, sec_alert_subscription, crypto_tax_ledger · Public sink: free_sample, token_launches_peek, sec_alerts_peek, sec_section_changes, company_profile, sec_market_alerts, scrape_markdown, site_map, domain_enrich, email_verify, counterparty_check, token_verdict, daily_briefing, wallet_risk_check, x402_preflight, sec_alert_subscription, daily_briefing_subscription · Destructive: free_sample.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
